The plan is eight hangars under a 50-year ground lease with no county appropriation. The county projects a $576 million financial impact over the lease term, including $66 million in direct ground-lease revenue to PDK. This is an approval, not a report that construction has begun.
facts.reference: DeKalb County news: BOC approves hangar development at PDK (item dated Dec. 1, 2025)

Commissioner Ted Terry proposed a moratorium on all new hangar development until the PDK master plan is updated, plus an FAA ban on night flights except for emergencies. The article reports these as proposals.
facts.reference: Rough Draft Atlanta: residents upset over PDK expansion (Dec. 10, 2025)
